main:1.text: This chapter features Nathan Drake and Victor Sullivan walking down the streets of London. As they do, the people in the surrounding building watch. The two walk in to Pelican Inn, being directed by the bartender to go to the upper floor. As they do, they are accompanied by Charlie Cutter and then Talbot. Before starting the negotiation, Charlie checks them for weapons.

main:2.text: Greatness from Small Beginnings is the second chapter of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Inspecting every display case in the Cartagena Museum will unlock the bronze trophy Quick Study. The story flashes back 12 years, when a 15-year-old Nathan Drake arrives at the Museo Marítimo located in Cartagena, Colombia and enters the museum looking for Francis Drake's ring.

main:3.text: This chapter is the continuation of where chapter two left off. It features a teenage Nathan Drake, and is set at the Museo Marítimo “Maritime Museum” of Cartagena, Republic of Colombia, as well as the rooftops in the local vicinity.

main:4.text: Talbot and Katherine Marlowe enter their black car, ramming Charlie Cutter on their way. Once the car had left, Nathan Drake and Victor Sullivan get up, revealing that Cutter's shooting them was just an elaborate ruse. Nathan complains to Cutter about the rough handling he received, Cutter states that Nate had told him to make the fight look convincing.

main:5.text: Standing on the crocodile in the Secret Library will unlock the bronze trophy Ride the Crocodile. After successfully fooling Marlowe, Talbot and their men, Drake, Sully, Chloe and Cutter break into the warehouse where the car was last seen. Inside are wet tyre tracks, but no vehicle. Drake discovers a secret entrance in the wall that leads to a makeshift tunnel, boring into the old network of service tunnels.

main:6.text: I. The fork in the path directly at the start of this chapter presents the illusion of a maze of paths through the dense forest, but the route to the chateau isn't that complicated. Make a detour to reach Treasure #23 when you reach a small stream, then head right when you reach the waterfall to first lay eyes on your destination. Head left as you leave the narrow path and collect Treasure #24. II.

main:7.text: Stay in the Light is the seventh chapter in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Completing the chapter in less than 9 minutes and 30 seconds in Drake's Deception Remastered will unlock the gold trophy Outrun the Flames. As Nathan Drake and Sully exit the tomb, they see Talbot and two agents pointing their weapons at them; a Para 9 and 2 AK-47 s to be exact.

main:8.text: The Citadel is the eighth chapter of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. After sneaking into the citadel  and finding Chloe Frazer and Charlie Cutter in one piece, Cutter shows Nate his notebook which says that Katherine Marlowe, Talbot and there agents are the same secret order which include Francis Drake, and Queen Elizabeth, and more from 400 years ago that from this day to 400 years ago they wanted exactly what…

main:9.text: Nate, Sully, Cutter, and Chloe make their way to find the other half of the amulet. I. Go down the secret passage. Once you have squeezed through the narrow tunnel, an unusual fist-fight begins. You can launch a few counterattacks, but your main priority is to evade blows with triangle and escape grabs with O. II. After the cutscenes end, drop down into the hole, enter the next chamber and collect Treasure #40.

main:10.text: Historical Research is the tenth chapter in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Hitting three enemies with fish in the market will unlock the bronze trophy "He's Gonna Need a Sturgeon" Nathan Drake and Victor Sullivan visit Yemen in search of clues to lead to Iram of the Pillars. They called Elena Fisher to help them enter the city without hassles, she gives them a permit cards so they can get through most checkpoints.

main:11.text: Nate and Elena argue over the former's motives and why he's doing this; she doesn't understand why he's putting everyone in danger and she soon admits that she is over the thrill of treasure hunting. She wants to move on. Sully soon comes back with the Sawed Off Shotguns, one for Elena and the other for himself, stopping their argument.

main:12.text: After Nate was knocked out cold by Rameses, he is held captive by his crew. Rameses tells Nate during a conversation that the old lady asked him to get rid of Nate, but since he was a nice guy, he would spare Nate if he tells him the location of Iram of the Pillars. Rameses insinuates that he also has Sully  in his custody, and that he will kill him if Nate does not give him the information.

main:13.text: Nate tries to to make his way onto Rameses’ ship, The Seaward. Along the way, he takes out some of the pirates. After being swept away by a big wave, he ends up on one of the pirates’ boats and is immediately attacked. He fends off the pirates and is then fired upon by men on a nearby boat. He fires a an RPG at the boat and sets it on fire. When the boat comes near to The Seaward, Nate jumps.

main:14.text:
Cruisin' for a Bruisin' is the fourteenth chapter in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Entering the swimming pool on the cruise ship will unlock the bronze trophy Marco Solo. After getting onboard of The Seaward, Nate sets out to find Sully. On the various decks, he has to fight Ramses' pirates time and time again. Finally, he  
makes his way into the hold and sees Sully tied to a chair with a bag over his head.

main:15.text: Nate finds out that Sully was not kidnapped by Rameses, and that it was a trap set by Rameses. He is then ambushed by Rameses' men. He shoots Rameses, who escapes. Nathan takes a grenade from one of the men and throws it. It lands on a pile of propane tanks and the explosion blows a huge hole in the side of the ship.

main:16.text: One Shot at This is the sixteenth chapter of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Completing the chapter in less than 12 minutes in Drake's Deception Remastered will unlock the X trophy Catch that Plane!. Nathan Drake has just escaped from the clutches of Marlowe, and arrived in Elena Fisher's apartment in Yemen. She tells him that Sully has been kidnapped, and they can board a cargo plane to catch up to him.

main:17.text: The chapter begins with Nathan Drake inside a cargo plane's inner maintenance crawlspace just beyond the landing gear chamber he used to infiltrate the cargoplane in the previous mission's ending several hours before. Nate crawls through the ventilation shafts of the plane, but is detected by a large brute which pulls him out of the vent and disarms Nate.

main:18.text: After Nathan Drake safely lands onto the dunes of the Rub' al Khali desert, he makes his way to the plane's wreckage to look for water or any other kind of supplies, but to no avail. With no map and no water, Nathan begins to wander aimlessly through the desert. Eventually, Nate stumbles across a well, but it's dry and filled with sand, much to his frustration. Nathan continues on, walking all day and all night.

main:19.text: After wandering the Rub' al Khali desert for days, Nathan Drake eventually sees a settlement. When he makes his way toward it, he discovers that it is nothing but a ghost town. Still hopeful, Nate searches for anything. He eventually finds a well, and although there is a small puddle of water, it's undrinkable. Nate presses on, and makes his way through the settlement. He finds a door, but its stuck.

main:20.text: Caravan is the twentieth chapter in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Defeating ten enemies using hand-to-hand combat on the back of the convoy trucks in Drake's Deception will unlock the bronze trophy Truck Brawler, and completing the chapter in less than 15 minutes in Drake's Deception Remastered will unlock the bronze trophy My Horse is Faster.

main:21.text: After arriving in Ubar, Drake and Sully begin to explore the city. They stumble upon a water fountain that Drake drinks out of, amazed that the water system still works. However, the two notice a solar eclipse, and suddenly, Sully is shot dead by Talbot.

main:22.text: The Dreamers of the Day is the twenty-second and final chapter of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. Completing the chapter without dying on Normal difficulty or harder in Drake's Deception Remastered will unlock the bronze trophy YOLO deceptively. At the spiral staircase's base, Nate meets Sully who tells him that he has hallucinated everything since he had drunk from the fountain.
